patch_description: Replace the random point generation with a deterministic multi-restart projected gradient ascent optimizer. The objective is a smooth soft-min (LogSumExp) approximation of the smallest triangle area over all 286 triangles, with a sharpening (annealing) parameter p that increases over iterations so the soft-min converges to the true minimum. Gradients are computed by vectorized central finite differences over all 26 coordinates in a single batched area evaluation (52 perturbed configurations at once), which is very cheap. Points are projected back onto the unit square each step (the problem is scale-invariant, and fixing the containing region makes maximizing raw min-area equivalent to maximizing the normalized ratio up to hull shape). Multiple restarts (random plus structured seeds like the regular 13-gon and 12-gon+center, which exploit the known 3-fold/rotational symmetry heuristics) are evaluated with the true metric (smallest triangle area / convex hull area), and the best configuration is returned. A fixed seed guarantees reproducibility. This should raise the normalized minimum triangle area from ~0.00 to the ~0.02-0.03 range, pushing combined_score near or above 1.0.
